intro.name: Ilan Nowak--Glandier
intro.description: Fullstack developer trained at 42, I build web and mobile applications end to end. Curious, rigorous and self-driven, I'm motivated by {{highlight1}} and turning ideas into real products.
intro.startup: I'm particularly drawn to the {{highlight}} — fast-paced environments where you build, ship, and iterate with real impact from day one.

moncab.description: Joined as the sole dev intern and quickly became autonomous across the entire codebase. Built the invitation system, v2 search algorithm (weighted scoring, 6 factors), Pennylane billing integration (invoicing, dynamic VAT, webhooks), Ubiflow listing syndication, owner dashboard with payment stats, and multiple Stripe security passes. 113+ commits in ~2 months.

leairn.title: leAIrn
leairn.description: Most people use AI badly because nobody teaches prompting as a skill. I built a Duolingo-style platform with 6 exercise types, AI-powered evaluation via Groq, full gamification (XP, streaks, badges, leaderboard), social features, and Stripe-based freemium/pro subscriptions.

nali.title: Nali
nali.description: Existing project management tools are overengineered for small dev teams. I built a lighter alternative with multi-org management, Kanban + sprints, real-time messaging, AES-256 encrypted docs, GitHub integration, WebRTC video calls, and Stripe billing with 4 plans.

setupia.title: setup.ia
setupia.description: Most devs coding with AI have no configuration file (CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules...) or copy generic templates. I built a platform that generates personalized AI config files based on the developer's context, skill level and goals — with an interactive questionnaire, premium domain-specific templates and a freemium model.

minishell.title: Minishell
minishell.description: Unix command interpreter in C — execution, redirections, pipes, environment variables and signal handling.

irc.title: IRC
irc.description: IRC server in C++ with non-blocking TCP sockets — multi-client handling, authentication, channels and real-time messaging.

transcendence.title: Transcendence
transcendence.description: Full-stack web app — real-time multiplayer Pong via WebSockets, auth, chat, stats and match history.

music_room.title: Music_Room
music_room.description: Mobile music sharing app — collaborative playlists, events, voting and personalized profiles with React Native and Node.js.

matcha.title: Matcha
matcha.description: Matcha is a social dating application. It allows users to create profiles, browse other profiles, send messages, and find matches based on shared interests. The application incorporates features such as geolocation, user preferences, and a real-time notification system. The project implements a full-stack architecture with a backend API, a database for user management, and an interactive frontend for an engaging user experience.

tokenizer.title: Tokenizer
tokenizer.description: Digital asset creation on the blockchain using Solidity — smart contract, deployment and web3 interaction.

learn2slither.title: Learn2Slither
learn2slither.description: A snake that learns to survive and feed autonomously using Q-Learning — local vision, Q-table, exploration/exploitation, trained from scratch with no ML library.

linear_regression.title: Linear_Regression
linear_regression.description: Car price prediction program using linear regression with gradient descent algorithm, implemented from scratch in Python.

multilayer_perceptron.title: Multilayer_Perceptron
multilayer_perceptron.description: Artificial neural networks through the implementation of a multilayer perceptron from scratch in Python.
